stories.headline: A record 180,000 giant tortoises roam one Seychelles atoll
stories.summary: A survey led by the Seychelles Islands Foundation and the University of Exeter counted about 180,000 Aldabra giant tortoises, the highest number ever recorded for the once-endangered species.
stories.why: Decades of protection brought this giant back from the brink.

stories.headline: Webb traced the most distant fast radio burst yet
stories.summary: The MeerKAT telescope caught a millisecond radio flash, and Webb found its home: a tiny dwarf galaxy seen just 3 billion years after the Big Bang. Most such bursts come from far later.
stories.why: It's a big clue to what makes these mystery flashes.

stories.headline: A Porto hospital lets patients' own pets visit them on the ward
stories.summary: Since July, São João hospital has let vaccinated, well-behaved pets visit long-stay patients on approval from their care team. It reports no infections so far.
stories.why: A visit from a beloved pet eases the loneliness of long hospital stays.

stories.stat_label: savings lost before volunteers stepped in
stories.headline: Hundreds of volunteers rebuilt a deaf family's ruined home
stories.summary: Ahmed and Rifat Ali lost £72,000 on an unsafe extension. Tradespeople and neighbours rebuilt the house for TV's DIY SOS, adding visual fire alarms and colour-changing alert lights.
stories.why: Strangers turned a family's worst loss into a home built around their needs.

fun_fact: Aldabra giant tortoises are among the largest tortoises in the world.
